lessons.title: Developmental Milestones: Infancy (0-12 months)

content_chunks.visual_description: Imagine a newborn with automatic 'survival programs' built in
details: **Moro Reflex (Startle)**: Baby throws arms out when startled - like catching themselves from falling. Disappears by 4-6 months.
**Rooting Reflex**: Touch baby's cheek, they turn toward it seeking food - nature's GPS for feeding. Gone by 4 months.
**Grasp Reflex**: Place finger in palm, baby grips tight - strong enough to support their weight! Fades by 6 months.
**Stepping Reflex**: Hold baby upright, legs make walking motions - practicing for later. Disappears by 2 months.
**Tonic Neck Reflex (Fencing)**: Turn baby's head, arm extends on that side - like a fencer's pose. Gone by 5-7 months.
content_chunks.mnemonic: **MRGS-T** = Moro, Rooting, Grasp, Stepping, Tonic neck - the 5 primitive reflexes you MUST know

content_chunks.visual_description: Watch Emma's motor skills progress like building blocks - each level builds on the last
details: **2 months**: Social smile (first real smile!), follows objects past midline, lifts head 45° when prone
**4 months**: Laughs, rolls front to back, brings hands to midline, bears weight on legs when held
**6 months**: Sits with support, transfers objects hand-to-hand, stranger anxiety begins, babbles consonants
**9 months**: Sits without support, crawls, pincer grasp (picks up Cheerios!), says 'mama/dada' non-specifically
**12 months**: Cruises (walks holding furniture), 2-3 words with meaning, understands 'no', waves bye-bye
content_chunks.mnemonic: **Rule of 6s for 6-month-old**: Sits up (6 letters), 6 months old, transfers objects between SIX fingers (sort of!)

content_chunks.visual_description: Listen to Emma's voice evolve from coos to words
details: **8 weeks**: Coos (vowel sounds: 'ooh', 'ahh')
**4 months**: Laughs out loud, squeals, orients to voice
**6 months**: Babbling (consonants: 'ba-ba', 'da-da')
**8-10 months**: Responds to name, understands 'no'
**12 months**: 2-3 words, follows simple commands
**18 months**: 10-25 words, points to body parts
**24 months**: 50+ words, 2-word phrases ('mommy up')
**5 years**: Complete sentences, tells stories

content_chunks.visual_description: See how Emma learns to connect with her world
details: **2 months**: Social smile - first intentional communication!
**6 months**: Stranger anxiety begins (cries with unfamiliar people)
**9 months**: Separation anxiety peaks (cries when parent leaves)
**12 months**: Shows preferences for people/toys, imitates gestures
content_chunks.clinical_pearl: 🔍 **RED FLAG**: No social smile by 3 months warrants developmental screening (possible autism spectrum disorder)

story_intro.text: Meet baby Emma, a 6-month-old visiting for her well-child check. Her mom anxiously asks, 'Is she developing normally?' Let's learn how to assess Emma's development using key milestones that tell us if she's on track.
story_intro.visual_cue: 🍼 Picture Emma sitting up with support, reaching for colorful toys, and babbling 'ba-ba-ba' to her parents.

clinical_pearls: **APGAR Scores**: Assessed at 1 and 5 minutes - Appearance, Pulse, Grimace, Activity, Respiration (score 0-2 each, 7-10 normal)
**Newborn Growth Parameters**: OFC (33-35cm), Length (48-53cm), Weight (2.5-4kg), Chest circumference (30-33cm)
**Vision Development**: Newborns see 8-12 inches (face distance during feeding). Color vision develops by 3-4 months.
**Hearing Screening**: All newborns get hearing test before hospital discharge (OAE or ABR)
**Tummy Time**: Start day one! Prevents flat spots (plagiocephaly) and strengthens neck muscles
red_flags: ❌ **By 2 months**: No social smile, not following faces
❌ **By 4 months**: Not bringing hands together, unable to support head
❌ **By 6 months**: No babbling, not rolling over, not reaching for objects
❌ **By 9 months**: No sitting without support, no stranger anxiety
❌ **By 12 months**: Not cruising, no words, not pointing
⚠️ **Loss of ANY previously acquired skill = IMMEDIATE concern**
